after_final.reset_cause_assessment: The SP805 stays armed from boot (load 60000000, about 20 s x 2) and nothing services it. OpenIPC loads wdt.ko only at the end of insert_ko in load_hisilicon (S70vendor); on this board the sensor id that ipcinfo detected and saved to the env is not in the insert_sns list, so insert_sns calls report_error and the script exits before insmod wdt.ko. The trial boot survived because it loaded wdt.ko itself. Inferred from the scripts and the timing; not yet observed from a shell or console.
